A '''human''' was a council member of [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|city]] on [[Duro]] during the [[Republic Era]]. When [[Niro]] visited the town hall, the human advised the [[marshal]] not to let his past relationship with [[Cad Bane]] cause the criminal's imminent return to escalate beyond control.<ref name="One Good Deed" />
